title: When LLMs Disagree: Diagnosing Relevance Filtering Bias and Retrieval Divergence in SDG Search
reasoning: The paper focuses on analyzing systematic bias and lexical divergence in how different Large Language Models filter and retrieve documents related to Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). While it mentions that these tasks have 'normative dimensions', the study itself is an evaluation of information retrieval performance and model disagreement rather than a study of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
